event_chain.summary: Unauthorized access to reservation data; guest contact details possibly viewed

summary: In April 2026 Booking.com detected suspicious activity affecting a number of reservations and determined that unauthorized third parties may have viewed booking details, guest names, email addresses, physical addresses, phone numbers and other information guests had shared with the accommodation. The company notified affected guests by email on April 12-13, reset reservation PINs and said payment data was not accessed. It did not say how the access occurred or how many people were affected; customers reported scammers contacting them with real reservation details.
